vlog_arc.theme: The week I stopped explaining and started showing.

beats.mon: Leo in the kitchen at 4am before training: 'I've been talking about this formula for two years — this week I want to show you what it actually looks like to live inside it.'
beats.tue: Camera on the desk mid-formulation review: 'Got a customer review today that stopped me — she said day one she was skeptical, day three something shifted — that's exactly what this is supposed to do.'
beats.wed: Leo post-training, still in kit: 'Two hours of Ironman prep, then the workday starts — the thing I keep realizing is that the formula isn't a hack, it's just removing the friction so I can actually show up.'
beats.thu: Quiet office, laptop open: 'I'm building this with AI, I'm building it with two kids at home, and I'm building it in public — today I wrote about why I stopped calling Power Coffee a coffee brand.'
beats.fri: Leo holding a bag of Power Coffee, natural light: 'Finished the week, no crash, no fog — not because everything went perfectly but because the foundation held — that's the only thing I'm trying to sell you.'
beats.sat: Weekend morning, Gabriel in the background: 'Saturday is when I remember why the formula matters — not for output, for presence — I want to be here, fully, and that starts with how the morning goes.'
beats.sun: Leo on a walk, camera low-key: 'Heading into next week with one question I want to answer publicly: what does it actually cost to build something real — I'll show you the number tomorrow morning.'
